title: 峨眉山月歌
author: 李白
note: 《峨眉山月歌》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【峨眉山月歌】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 峨眉山月半轮秋。影入平羌江水流。夜发青溪向三峡。思君不见下渝州。
appr: 《峨眉山月歌》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「峨眉山月半轮秋。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《峨眉山月歌》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

theme: 《峨眉山月歌》主旨在于表现边塞征戍之苦与家国豪情。；描绘自然山水之美，寄托隐逸或热爱自然之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代李白的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Above Mount Emei, the autumn moon hangs in half its disk.
Its shadow falls upon the Pingqiang, drifting with the current.
At night I leave Qingxi, setting out toward the Three Gorges.
Longing for you yet unable to meet, I drift onward to Yuzhou.

title: 庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟
author: 李白
note: 【庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 我本楚狂人，鳳歌笑孔丘。手持綠玉杖，朝別黃鶴樓。五嶽尋仙不辭遠，一生好入名山遊。廬山秀出南斗傍，屏風九疊雲錦張，影落明湖青黛光。金闕前開二峰長，銀河倒挂三石梁。香爐瀑布遙相望，迴厓沓嶂凌蒼蒼。翠影紅霞映朝日，鳥飛不到吳天長。登高壯觀天地間，大江茫茫去不還。黃雲萬里動風色，白波九道流雪山。好爲廬山謠，興因廬山發。閑窺石鏡清我心，謝公行處蒼苔沒。早服還丹無世情，琴心三疊道初成。遙見仙人綵雲裏，手把芙蓉朝玉京。先期汗漫九垓上，願接盧敖遊太清。
appr: 《庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《庐山谣寄卢侍御虚舟》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: I am by nature the madman of Chu,
Singing the Phoenix Song to mock Confucius himself.
In my hand I hold a staff of green jade,
At dawn I bid farewell to the Yellow Crane Tower.
To seek immortals on the Five Peaks I spare no distance,
All my life I have loved to wander through famous mountains.
Mount Lu rises in beauty beside the Southern Dipper,
Its nine-fold screen-like peaks spread out like cloud brocade,
Their shadows falling on the bright lake with hues of dark indigo.
Before the Golden Gate, two peaks stretch far into the distance,
The Silver River hangs upside down over the Three Stone Bridges.
Censer Peak's waterfall gazes at it from afar,
Winding cliffs and stacked peaks rise toward the blue vault of heaven.
Emerald shadows and crimson clouds glow against the morning sun,
Where even birds cannot reach, the sky of Wu stretches endlessly.
Climbing high, I gaze upon the grandeur of heaven and earth,
The great river flows vast and boundless, never to return.
Yellow clouds for ten thousand miles stir the colors of the wind,
Nine channels of white waves surge like moving mountains of snow.
I love to sing my song of Mount Lu,
My inspiration roused by the mountain's majesty.
Idly I peer into the Stone Mirror, cleansing my heart,
Where Xie Lingyun once trod, green moss now covers all.
Long ago I took the elixir, shedding worldly desires,
My threefold lute-heart achieved, the Dao begins to take form.
Far off I see immortals among the colored clouds,
Holding lotus blossoms as they journey to the Jade Capital.
I made my appointment with Han Man beyond the nine heavens,
Wishing to meet Lu Ao and wander the Great Clearness together.

baihua_lines: 我本是像楚狂接舆那样的狂人，
高唱凤歌嘲笑孔丘那种汲汲于仕途的人。
手里拿着绿玉装饰的手杖，
清晨就辞别了黄鹤楼。
到五岳寻访仙人从来不嫌路途遥远，
我这一生就喜爱进入名山游览。
庐山挺拔秀丽，高耸在南斗星旁，
九叠屏风般的山峰像云锦般铺展开来，
山影倒映在明净的湖面上，泛着青黑色的光。
金阙岩前两座山峰遥遥相对、绵延伸展，
三石梁的瀑布像银河倒挂在山间。
香炉峰的瀑布与它遥遥相望，
曲折的悬崖和层叠的山峰直插苍茫青天。
翠绿山影与灿烂红霞映照着朝阳，
连飞鸟都到不了的地方，吴地的天空分外辽远。
登高望远，壮观的景象尽在天地之间，
大江浩浩荡荡向东流去，一去不回。
黄云万里，天色随风变幻，
长江九道支流白浪翻滚，像流动的雪山。
我喜爱为庐山写下歌谣，
诗兴因庐山的壮美而勃发。
悠闲地对着石镜照见自己，心境变得清净，
当年谢灵运走过的地方，早已被青苔覆盖。
我早已服食仙丹，了却世俗的情欲，
琴心三叠修炼完成，道业刚刚有所成就。
远远望见仙人们站在彩云之间，
手捧着莲花飞向玉京朝拜天帝。
我早已和汗漫相约在九天之上，
希望能像卢敖那样，接你同游太清仙境。

title: 怨情
author: 李白
note: 《怨情》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【怨情】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 新人如花雖可寵，故人似玉由來重。花性飄揚不自持，玉心皎潔終不移。故人昔新今尚故，還見新人有故時。請看陳后黃金屋，寂寂珠簾生網絲。

bg: 《怨情》为唐代李白所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者李白在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
theme: 《怨情》主旨在于抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。；登临怀古，借古抒怀，寄寓历史兴亡之感。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代李白的代表性作品之一。
en_body: The new love is like a flower, charming to dote upon,
Yet the old friend is like fine jade, valued through the ages.
The flower's nature is drifting, unable to hold itself steady,
But the heart of jade, pure and bright, never changes.
The old friend was once new, and now is old,
You too shall see this new love grow old in time.
Look, I pray you, at the Golden House where Empress Chen once dwelt,
Now silent and desolate, cobwebs strung across its pearl curtains.
translation: 新人如花雖可寵，故人似玉由來重。花性飄揚不自持，玉心皎潔終不移。故人昔新今尚故，還見新人有故時。請看陳后黃金屋，寂寂珠簾生網絲。
appreciation: 《怨情》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《怨情》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

title: 早发白帝城
author: 李白
note: 【千里】形容路途遥远。；【早发白帝城】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 朝辞白帝彩云间。千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住。轻舟巳过万重山。
appr: 《早发白帝城》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。全诗共四句，为绝句体裁，篇幅短小而意蕴丰厚。起句以「朝辞白帝彩云间。」落笔，勾勒意境；承句延展画面，转句翻出新意，合句收束余韵。短短二十余字，韵味深厚，凝练含蓄。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《早发白帝城》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

title: 春思
author: 李白
note: 《春思》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【春思】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 燕草如碧絲，秦桑低綠枝。當君懷歸日，是妾斷腸時。春風不相識，何事入羅幃。

en_body: In Yan the spring grass has just sprouted, green as silk threads,
In Qin the mulberry branches already hang heavy with leaves.
When you, far away, are longing to return home,
Here at home my heart breaks with longing for you.
Spring wind, you and I have never known each other,
Why then do you blow through my silken bedcurtains?

title: 月下独酌
author: 李白
note: 【明月】皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。；【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。
tr: 花间一壶酒，独酌无相亲。举杯邀明月，对影成三人。月既不解饮，影徒随我身。暂伴月将影，行乐须及春。我歌月徘徊，我舞影零乱。醒时同交欢，醉后各分散。永结无情游，相期邈云汉。

theme: 《月下独酌》主旨在于表达喜悦、欢畅或旷达之情。；歌咏爱情与相思之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代李白的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Amid the flowers, a single pot of wine,
I pour alone, with no one close at hand.
Raising my cup, I beckon the bright moon to join me,
And with my shadow in the moonlight, we make three.
The moon, alas, knows nothing of drinking,
And my shadow only follows my body in vain.
For now I'll keep company with moon and shadow,
Seizing joy before the springtime slips away.
I sing, and the moon seems to linger and listen,
I dance, and my shadow tangles and sways with me.
While sober still, we share our merriment together,
Once drunk, each goes our separate way.
Let us seal this bond of passionless friendship,
Meeting again on the far banks of the Silver River.

notes.explanation: 皎洁的月亮，古典诗词中常寄托思乡、怀人之情。
酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。

title: 梦游天姥吟留别
author: 李白
body: 熊咆龙吟殷岩泉，栗深林兮惊层巅。
云青青兮欲雨，水澹澹兮生烟。
霓为衣兮风为马，云之君兮纷纷而来下。
虎鼓瑟兮鸾回车，仙之人兮列如麻。
note: 【兮】楚辞及古诗常见语气词，相当于"啊"，用于舒缓节奏、增强咏叹意味。；【流水】流动的水，常喻时光流逝、愁绪绵长。
tr: 海客談瀛洲，煙濤微茫信難求。越人語天姥，雲霓明滅或可覩。天姥連天向天橫，勢拔五嶽掩赤城。天台四萬八千丈，對此欲倒東南傾。我欲因之夢吳越，一夜飛度鏡湖月。湖月照我影，送我至剡溪。謝公宿處今尚在，淥水蕩漾清猨啼。脚著謝公屐，身登青雲梯。半壁見海日，空中聞天雞。千巖萬轉路不定，迷花倚石忽已暝。熊咆龍吟殷巖泉，慄深林啊，驚層巔。雲青青啊，欲雨，水澹澹啊，生煙。列缺霹靂，丘巒崩摧。洞天石扇，訇然中開。青冥浩蕩不見底，日月照耀金銀臺。霓爲衣啊，風爲馬，雲之君啊，紛紛而來下。虎鼓瑟啊，鸞迴車，仙之人啊，列如麻。忽魂悸以魄動，怳驚起而長嗟。惟覺時之枕席，失向來之煙霞。世間行樂亦如此，古來萬事東流水。別君去時何時還，且放白鹿青崖間，須行即騎訪名山。安能摧眉折腰事權貴？使我不得開心顏。
appr: 《梦游天姥吟留别》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。作品取法楚辞骚体，多用"兮"字调节节奏，句式长短错落，情感浓烈奔放，富于浪漫色彩。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《梦游天姥吟留别》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

theme: 《梦游天姥吟留别》主旨在于抒写羁旅思乡之情，表达对故土亲人的深切思念。；抒发离愁别绪与对友人的惜别之情。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将情感寄寓于景物与叙事之中，含蓄深沉，意蕴丰厚，千百年来引发读者广泛共鸣，是唐代李白的代表性作品之一。
en_body: Seafarers speak of Yingzhou, the immortal isle,
Lost in mist and waves, truly hard to find.
But when the people of Yue speak of Tianmu Mountain,
Through shifting clouds and light it may sometimes be glimpsed.
Tianmu rises to the sky, linking heaven itself, stretching across the horizon,
Its peaks surmount the Five Holy Mountains, overshadowing Chicheng.
Tiantai Mountain stands forty-eight thousand zhang tall,
Yet beside Tianmu it seems to tilt and bow toward the southeast.
And so I longed to journey in dream to the lands of Wu and Yue,
In one night flying across Mirror Lake under the bright moon.
The moonlight on Mirror Lake cast my shadow before me,
And escorted me all the way to Shan Creek.
Where Xie Lingyun once dwelled can still be found today,
Clear waters rippling, monkeys crying with shrill, clear calls.
On my feet I wore the wooden clogs Xie Lingyun himself made,
Climbing in person the mountain paths that scale the very clouds.
Halfway up the slope, I saw the sun rising from the sea,
And high in the air I heard the Heavenly Cock crow the dawn.
Countless twisted rocks, winding paths that turned and twisted,
Enchanted by flowers, resting against stones, I did not notice night falling.
Bears roared, dragons howled, resounding through rock and stream, making deep forests tremble and layered peaks shake with dread.
The clouds turned black and heavy, threatening rain, the waters stirred and rose, throwing up a mist.
Lightning flashed,
Thunder roared, as if mountain peaks themselves were crumbling and collapsing.
The stone gates of the immortal palace,
With a great roar, swung open from within.
Inside, an azure sky stretched boundless, endless,
Sun and moon shining upon palaces of gold and silver.
Clad in rainbows, riding upon the wind, the immortals of the clouds descended, one after another.
Tigers played upon zithers, phoenixes drew their chariots, Immortals crowded by, dense as hemp in a field.
Suddenly my soul shook,
I woke with a start, and sighed a long, deep sigh.
Awake to find only my pillow and mat beside me,
The mist and clouds of my dream had all vanished away.
All the joys of the human world are just like this,
Since ancient times, all things flow east like water, never returning.
After I part from you, when shall I come back again?
For now I shall pasture my white deer among the green cliffs,
And when I must go, ride it forth to visit famous mountains.
How could I bow my head and serve the powerful and highborn,
Letting myself be robbed of a happy, free smile!
lines: 熊咆龙吟殷岩泉，栗深林兮惊层巅。
云青青兮欲雨，水澹澹兮生烟。
霓为衣兮风为马，云之君兮纷纷而来下。
虎鼓瑟兮鸾回车，仙之人兮列如麻。

baihua_lines: 航海的人谈起海外的瀛洲仙山，
烟波渺茫，实在难以寻找。
越地的人说起天姥山，
在云霞明灭间有时还能看见。
天姥山高耸入云，连接着天际，横亘在天外，
山势高峻超过五岳，遮掩过赤城山。
天台山高达四万八千丈，
对着天姥山也好像要向东南倾斜拜倒。
我因此想要梦到吴越一带，
一夜之间就飞渡过了明月映照下的镜湖。
镜湖上的月光照着我的影子，
一直送我到了剡溪。
谢灵运当年住过的地方至今还在，
清澈的湖水荡漾，猿猴的啼声清厉。
我脚上穿着谢灵运当年特制的木屐，
亲身攀登着那直上云霄的山路。
半山腰就看见了从海上升起的太阳，
半空中传来了天鸡报晓的啼叫。
无数山岩重叠，道路曲折盘旋，方向不定，
我正迷恋着花，依倚着石，不觉天色已经晚了。
熊在咆哮，龙在长吟，震响在岩石和泉水之间，使深林战栗，使层层山峰震惊。
云层黑沉沉的，像是要下雨，水波动荡生起了烟雾。
电光闪闪，
雷声轰鸣，山峰好像要被崩塌似的。
仙府的石门，
訇的一声从中间打开。
洞中蔚蓝的天空广阔无际，看不到尽头，
日月照耀着金银铸成的宫阙。
用彩虹做衣裳，把长风当作马，云中的神仙们纷纷下来。
老虎弹奏着琴瑟，鸾鸟驾着车，仙人们成群结队，密密麻麻像麻一样多。
忽然惊魂动魄，
恍然惊醒，长长地叹息。
醒来时只有身边的枕席，
刚才梦中所见的烟雾云霞全都消失了。
人世间的欢乐也不过如此，
自古以来万事都像东流的水一样一去不复返。
与君分别之后，什么时候才能回来？
暂且把白鹿放牧在青崖间，
等到要走的时候就骑它去访问名山。
我怎么能够低头弯腰去侍奉那些权贵，
让我自己不能有舒心畅意的笑颜！

title: 清平调·其一
author: 李白
note: 【春风】春日和风，常喻恩泽、喜悦或美好时光。；【清平调·其一】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓。若非群玉山头见，会向瑶台月下逢。

en_body: I sailed across the river beyond Mount Jingmen,
Coming to journey through the ancient land of Chu.
The mountains faded away as the level plains unfolded,
The great river flowed onward through the endless wilderness.
The moon reflected in the water like a celestial mirror flying down,
Clouds formed and wove into mirages of cities in the sky.
Still I cherish the waters that come from my homeland,

en_translation: I sailed across the river beyond Mount Jingmen,
Coming to journey through the ancient land of Chu.
The mountains faded away as the level plains unfolded,
The great river flowed onward through the endless wilderness.

Clouds formed and wove into mirages of cities in the sky.
Still I cherish the waters that come from my homeland,
Carrying my boat ten thousand li, seeing me off on my long journey.

Egret Islet splits the Yangtze into two streams.
The floating clouds in the sky always cover the sun,
And not seeing Chang'an fills my heart with sorrow.

background: 《登金陵凤凰台》为唐代李白所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者李白在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Once the phoenix came to roam upon Phoenix Terrace,
The phoenix has flown, the terrace is empty, only the river still flows on alone.
Flowers and grasses of the Wu palace bury the quiet paths,
The great lords of Jin times have long become mounds in ancient tombs.
The Three Mountains appear half beyond the blue sky,
Egret Islet splits the Yangtze into two streams.
The floating clouds in the sky always cover the sun,
And not seeing Chang'an fills my heart with sorrow.
baihua_lines: 凤凰台上曾经有凤凰来游憩，
凤凰飞去之后，台空了，只有江水依然独自奔流。
吴国宫殿里的花花草草，埋没在幽静的小径里，
东晋时代的那些达官贵人，早已成了古墓中的荒丘。
三山的半截山峰，仿佛落在青天外面，
白鹭洲把长江分成两条水道。
天上的浮云总是遮蔽着太阳，
看不见长安，使我心中满怀忧愁。

title: 蜀道难
author: 李白
body: 嗟尔远道之人胡为乎来哉！
note: 《蜀道难》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【蜀道难】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 噫吁戲！危乎高啊！蜀道之難難於上青天！蠶叢及魚鳧，開國何茫然。爾來四萬八千歲，不與秦塞通人煙。西當太白有鳥道，可以橫絕峨眉巔。地崩山摧壯士死，然後天梯石棧相鉤連。上有六龍回日之高標，下有衝波逆折之回川。黃鶴之飛尚不得過，猨猱欲度愁攀援。青泥何盤盤，百步九折縈巖巒。捫參歷井仰脅息，以手撫膺坐長歎。問君西遊何時還？畏途巉巖不可攀。但見悲鳥號古木，雄飛雌從繞林間。又聞子規啼夜月，愁空山，蜀道之難難於上青天，使人聽此凋朱顏。連峯去天不盈尺，枯松倒挂倚絕壁。飛湍瀑流爭喧豗，砅厓轉石萬壑雷。其險也如此，嗟爾遠道之人胡爲乎來啊！劒閣崢嶸而崔嵬，一夫當關，萬夫莫開。所守或匪親，化爲狼與豺。朝避猛虎，夕避長蛇。磨牙吮血，殺人如麻。錦城雖云樂，不如早還家。蜀道之難難於上青天，側身西望長咨嗟。

en_body: Alas-a-me!
How sheer, how perilously high!
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
Cancong and Yufu, ancient kings of Shu,
How lost in the mists of time was their founding of the kingdom!
Forty-eight thousand years have passed since those days,
Yet Qin and Shu remained cut off by the mountains, no intercourse between them.
On the west, Taibai Mountain has only a path birds can traverse,
A track by which one might cross the very summit of Emei.
The earth split, the mountain crumbled, five heroes of Shu perished,
Only then were sky-ladders and plank roads built to connect the two lands.
Above stands the highest peak where even the sun god's chariot must turn back,
Below, the rushing, churning, winding torrent twists and eddies.
Even the yellow crane, that highest-flying bird, cannot cross it,
Even agile gibbons despair of climbing it, for all their skill.
How winding and twisting is the path over Qingni Ridge,
Every hundred paces it loops nine times around the mountain slopes.
Travelers can reach the stars Shen and Jing, holding their breath as they gaze upward,
Clutching their chests in terror, sighing long and deep in vain.
Dear friend, I ask you: when will you return from this westward journey into Shu?
This fearsome road is too dangerous, too sheer and steep to climb.
I see only mournful birds crying in ancient trees,
Male and female flying together through the desolate woods.
And I hear the cuckoo crying in the moonlit night,
Its sorrow ringing through the empty mountains,
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
Hearing these words makes one's face turn pale in an instant.
Continuous peaks rise less than a foot from heaven itself,
Withered pines hang upside down, leaning against the sheer precipices.
Flying rapids and cascades vie in roaring clamor,
Waters dashing against boulders, pounding cliffs, thundering through thousands of valleys.
The road to Shu is this dangerous,
Ah me! O traveler come from afar, why did you ever come here?
Jian'ge Pass is lofty and precipitous,
One man guards the gate,
And ten thousand cannot force it.
If the general defending it is not a trusted kinsman,
He will turn into a wolf or jackal preying on passersby.
In the morning you must avoid fierce tigers,
In the evening you must guard against long serpents.
They sharpen their fangs, suck blood and devour flesh,
The men they kill number as many as hemp stalks in a field.
Though Jincheng is said to be a place of pleasure,
It is better to hurry home early.
The road to Shu is harder to climb than scaling the very sky!
I turn my face westward and cannot help but heave a long, deep sigh!

baihua_lines: 哎呀呀！
多么险峻、多么高耸啊！
蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
蚕丛和鱼凫这两位古代蜀王，
他们开国的事迹是多么渺茫遥远啊！
从那时以来经历了四万八千岁，
秦蜀两地被秦岭阻隔，人们从不曾互相往来。
西边太白山只有飞鸟能过的小道，
从那小路走可以横渡峨眉山顶端。
山崩地裂，蜀国五位壮士被压死，
然后两地才有天梯栈道开始相通连。
上面有太阳神的车驾也要掉头的高峰，
下面有波涛滚滚、回旋曲折的激流。
善于高飞的黄鹤尚且无法飞过，
即使猿猱想要攀过也愁于无法攀援。
青泥岭的山路是多么曲折绕弯，
百步之内就要绕着山峦转九道弯。
行人可以摸到参星、触到井星，仰头屏息，
用手抚胸惊恐不已，徒然长吁短叹。
好朋友啊，请问你西游入蜀什么时候回来？
可怕的山道实在太艰险，陡峭高峻难以攀登。
只见悲鸟在古树上哀鸣啼叫，
雄雌相随飞翔在荒凉的树林之间。
又听见月夜里杜鹃声声啼叫，
在这空山中悲鸣，
蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
让人听了这话，顿时脸色都变了。
连绵的山峰离天不到一尺远，
枯老的松树倒挂着，斜倚在绝壁之上。
飞奔的激流和瀑布争相喧闹着，
流水撞击着巨石、冲击山崖，在千山万壑间发出雷鸣般的轰响。
蜀道如此艰险，
唉呀呀，你这位远道而来的客人，为什么要到这里来呢？
剑阁关高峻又高大，
一个人把守关口，
千军万马也攻不下。
把守关口的将领如果不是亲信，
就会变成害人的豺狼。
早晨要躲避猛虎，
傍晚要提防长蛇。
它们磨尖牙齿，吮血食肉，
杀死的人多如乱麻。
锦城虽说快乐，
还是不如早早回家。
蜀道真太难攀登，简直比登天还难！
我侧身向西望去，禁不住长长地叹息！

title: 行路难·其一
author: 李白
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。
tr: 金樽清酒斗十千，玉盘珍羞直万钱。停杯投箸不能食，拔剑四顾心茫然。欲渡黄河冰塞川，将登太行雪满山。闲来垂钓碧溪上，忽复乘舟梦日边。行路难，行路难，多歧路，今安在？长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海。

en_body: Clear wine in golden cups costs ten thousand cash a dou,
Precious delicacies on jade plates are worth ten thousand more.
Yet in my sorrow I lay down cup and chopsticks, unable to eat,
I draw my sword and gaze around me, my heart lost in confusion.
I wish to cross the Yellow River, but ice and snow block the stream,
I would climb Taihang Mountain, but blizzards have sealed the passes.
Once I fished like Jiang Taigong upon the green brook,
Or like Yi Yin who dreamed he sailed a boat past the sun.
The road through life is hard!
How hard it is!
So many branching paths before me,
Where am I now?
I believe a day will come when I ride the long wind, cleaving ten thousand waves,
Hoisting my cloud sail high to sail boldly across the vast sea!

baihua_lines: 金杯中的美酒一斗价值十千钱，
玉盘里珍贵的菜肴价值万钱。
胸中郁闷啊，我放下杯子和筷子吃不下饭，
拔出宝剑环顾四周，心里一片茫然。
想渡黄河，冰雪却堵塞了这条大川，
要登太行山，莽莽风雪早已封山。
像姜太公吕尚在碧溪上垂钓，
又像伊尹做梦，乘船经过日边。

多么艰难！

如今身在何处？

高高挂起云帆，在沧海中勇往直前！

tr: 吾愛孟夫子，風流天下聞。紅顏棄軒冕，白首臥松雲。醉月頻中聖，迷花不事君。高山安可仰，徒此揖清芬。

en_body: I deeply respect and love Master Meng,
Whose free and noble spirit is known throughout the world.
In youth you disdained official rank and honor, casting aside carriage and cap,
In white-haired old age you rest among pines and clouds, withdrawn to the hills.
Under the bright moon you often lie in drunken bliss,
Lost among mountains and streams, unwilling to serve the emperor.
How can one look up to such mountain-like loftiness?
I can only bow to you here, revering your fragrant virtue.

您的潇洒风度天下闻名。
您少年时就鄙视功名，弃官不做，

我只能在此向您揖拜，敬慕您芬芳的德行。

en_translation: Li Bai was about to depart by boat, on the point of leaving,
When suddenly I heard the sound of stamping and singing coming from the shore.

桃花潭水纵然有千尺深，
也比不上汪伦送我的情谊深厚。

They cannot equal the depth of Wang Lun's friendship in seeing me off.

author: 李白

en_body: Green mountains lie across the northern outskirts of the city,
White waters go winding around the eastern wall.
Here we must part once and for all,
And you, like a lone tumbleweed, will drift ten thousand miles on your journey.
The floating clouds are like the wanderer's uncertain course,
The setting sun hangs low, like the old friend's reluctant heart.
We wave our hands and take our leave from this place,
Our parting horses neigh long and mournfully, stirring infinite sorrow.

author: 李白
note: 《送孟浩然之广陵》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【送孟浩然之广陵】唐代李白所作的诗。

The Wu maiden presses new wine, inviting guests to taste it.
The young friends of Jinling come one after another to see me off,
Those leaving and those staying all raise their cups and drain them.
I ask you, pray ask the east-flowing waters of the Yangtze,
Which is longer — the sorrow of parting, or the river itself?

en_translation: Spring wind blows, willow catkins fill the sky, the wineshop is filled with fragrance,
The Wu maiden presses new wine, inviting guests to taste it.
The young friends of Jinling come one after another to see me off,
Those leaving and those staying all raise their cups and drain them.
I ask you, pray ask the east-flowing waters of the Yangtze,
Which is longer — the sorrow of parting, or the river itself?

金陵的年轻朋友们纷纷前来为我送行，
要走的人和送行的人，各自举起酒杯饮尽。

是离别的情意长，还是这江水更长？

title: 长干行
author: 李白
note: 《长干行》是李白的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【长干行】唐代李白所作的诗。
tr: 憶昔深閨裏，煙塵不曾識。嫁與長干人，沙頭候風色。五月南風興，思君下巴陵。八月西風起，想君發[揚]子。去來悲如何，見少離別多。湘潭幾日到，妾夢越風波。昨夜狂風度，吹折江頭樹。淼淼暗無邊，行人在何處。北客真三公，朱衣滿江中。薄暮來投宿，數朝不肯東。好乘浮雲驄，佳期蘭渚東。鴛鴦綠浦上，翡翠錦屏中。自憐十五餘，顏色桃花紅。那作商人婦，愁水復愁風。
appr: 《长干行》是唐代李白所作的诗名篇。作品采用四言为主的句式，古朴厚重，直陈其事，是先秦古诗典型风格。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《长干行》历代传诵不衰，是李白诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: I remember when I lived deep in the inner chambers,
I had never known the dust and smoke of the world.
I married a man of Changgan,
Waiting by the sandbar for the wind to change.
In May the south wind rises,
Longing for you, I follow you down to Baling.
In August the west wind blows,
Thinking of you setting out from Yangzi Ford.
In all this coming and going, how great the sorrow,
Few the meetings, many the partings.
How many days to reach Xiangtan?
My dreaming soul crosses wind and waves to seek you.
Last night a fierce wind passed,
Breaking trees at the river's head.
The waters stretch vast and dark, without bound,
Where can the traveler be now?
Northern visitors are truly noble lords,
Men in crimson robes fill the river.
At dusk they come to seek lodging,
For many days they refuse to travel east.
Let us ride the fine dappled steeds like floating clouds,
The trysting place lies east of the Orchid Islet.
Mandarin ducks sport upon the green shore,
Kingfishers among the brocade screens.
Pity me, barely over fifteen years old,
My complexion still pink as peach blossoms.
How did I become a merchant's wife,
Worrying over dangerous waters, fearing fierce winds?

连世上的烟尘战火都不曾见过。
嫁给长干里的人为妻，
在沙头等候风向变化。
五月里南风兴起，
思念你，我随君下巴陵。
八月里西风吹起，
想你从扬子津出发。
来去之间，悲伤是如何，
相见的日子少，离别的日子多。
到湘潭需要几天，
我的梦魂跨越风波去寻你。
昨夜狂风大作，
吹断了江头的树木。
江水茫茫昏暗无边，
远行的人现在在哪里？
北方来的客人真是三公贵人，
穿着朱红官服的人布满江中。
傍晚时分前来投宿，
好多天了仍不肯向东而行。

佳期就在兰渚之东。
鸳鸯在绿浦之上嬉戏，
翡翠鸟在锦屏之中。
可怜我才十五岁多一点，
容颜还像桃花那样红艳。
怎么做了商人的妻子，
既要担心水险，又要担心风恶。

title: 长相思·其一
author: 李白
note: 【长安】汉唐都城，在今陕西西安，诗词中常借指帝都、理想之地。；【相思】彼此思念，多指男女之间或友人之间的深切思念。；【梦】梦境，常喻虚幻、追忆或心愿。

en_body: Endless longing,
In Chang'an.
The autumn cricket chirps by the golden well railing,
Thin frost lies chill, the bamboo mat grows cold.
A single lamp burns dim, my longing almost breaks me,
I roll up the curtain, gaze at the moon, and sigh in vain.
My beloved, fair as flowers, is separated by the clouds!
Above is the dark, infinite expanse of high heaven,
Below are the waves of clear green waters.
Heaven is high, the road is far, my soul flies in torment as I search,
Barred by mountains and passes, even dreams cannot cross.
Endless longing,
It breaks my very heart!

在长安。
络纬秋虫在金井栏边啼叫，

摧折心肝！

I roll up the curtain, gaze at the moon, and sigh in vain.

Above is the dark, infinite expanse of high heaven,
Below are the waves of clear green waters.
Heaven is high, the road is far, my soul flies in torment as I search,
Barred by mountains and passes, even dreams cannot cross.
Long think of sun night yet still.
It breaks my very heart!

title: 夜上受降城闻笛
author: 李益

en_body: By day we climb the hills to watch for beacon fire on the watchtowers,
At dusk we water our horses along the banks of the Jiao River.
Travelers hear the sound of the watch gong amid the dim sandstorm,
And the princess's lute echoes with endless sorrow and complaint.
The vast wilderness stretches ten thousand li under wild clouds, without a city in sight,
Snow falls in flurries, merging with the great desert.
Barbarian geese cry mournfully as they fly night after night,
And the Tartar soldiers shed tears that fall in pairs.
We hear that the Jade Gate Pass is still barred by the court,
And soldiers must follow their general's chariot, driving themselves on.
Year after year, the bones of the fallen are buried beyond the frontier,
All in vain, that grapes from the Western Regions might be planted in Han palace gardens.
translation: 白日登山望烽火，黃昏飲馬傍交河。行人刁斗風沙暗，公主琵琶幽怨多。野雲萬里無城郭，雨雪紛紛連大漠。胡鴈哀鳴夜夜飛，胡兒眼淚雙雙落。聞道玉門猶被遮，應將性命逐輕車。年年戰骨埋荒外，空見蒲桃入漢家。
appreciation: 《古从军行》是唐代李颀所作的诗名篇。全诗共12句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《古从军行》历代传诵不衰，是李颀诗歌风格的集中体现。

黄昏时分牵着马到交河岸边让马饮水。
行人在昏暗的风沙中听到刁斗之声，
公主的琵琶声中充满了幽怨。
茫茫旷野万里无云，不见城郭，
雨雪纷纷，连接着大漠。
胡地的大雁夜夜哀鸣着飞过，
胡人的眼泪双双坠落。
听说玉门关还被朝廷阻断，
士兵们只能跟着将军的车驾拼命奔波。
年年战骨埋在荒野之外，
只换来西域的葡萄种进了汉家宫苑。

title: 古意
author: 李颀
note: 《古意》是李颀的经典作品，语言凝练，意境深远，为历代读者所传诵。【古意】唐代李颀所作的诗。
tr: 男兒事長征，少小幽燕客。賭勝馬蹄下，由來輕七尺。殺人莫敢前，鬚如蝟毛磔。黃雲隴底白雪飛，未得報恩不能歸。遼東小婦年十五，慣彈琵琶解歌舞。今爲羗笛出塞聲，使我三軍淚如雨。

en_body: A true man is meant to go on distant military campaigns,
From youth a sojourner in the You and Yan regions.
Vying for victory beneath the horses' hooves,
He has long held his seven-foot body light.
Slaughtering the foe so that none dare approach,
His whiskers bristling like hedgehog spines.
Yellow clouds hang over the fields, white snow flies,
Having not yet repaid the nation's grace, he cannot return home.
A young wife of Liaodong, only fifteen years old,
Skilled at playing the lute, adept at song and dance.
Now the Qiang flute sounds an air beyond the frontier,
Making the soldiers of our three armies shed tears like rain.

从小就客居幽燕一带。
在马蹄之下赌胜争强，
从来就把七尺之躯看得很轻。
拼杀时敌人不敢近前，
胡须像刺猬毛一样张开。
黄云笼罩着田野，白雪纷飞，
还没有报答国恩，不能归去。
辽东的少妇年仅十五，
惯于弹奏琵琶，能歌善舞。
如今羌笛吹出塞外的声音，
使我三军将士泪下如雨。

title: 听安万善吹觱篥歌
author: 李颀
note: 【酒】酒，古典诗词中常用于遣怀、送别、消愁。；【听安万善吹觱篥歌】唐代李颀所作的诗。
tr: 南山截竹爲觱篥，此樂本自龜茲出。流傳漢地曲轉奇，涼州胡人爲我吹。傍鄰聞者多歎息，遠客思鄉皆淚垂。世人解聽不解賞，長飆風中自來往。枯桑老柏寒颼飀，九雛鳴鳳亂啾啾。龍吟虎嘯一時發，萬籟百泉相與秋。忽然更作漁陽摻，黃雲蕭條白日暗。變調如聞楊柳春，上林繁花照眼新。歲夜高堂列明燭，美酒一杯聲一曲。

en_body: Bamboo cut from the southern mountains is fashioned into the bili pipe,
This instrument originally came from the kingdom of Kucha.
After spreading to Han lands, its melodies grew even more wondrous,
A barbarian from Liangzhou plays it for me.
Neighbors who hear it mostly heave sighs,
Travelers far from home all shed homesick tears.
Worldly people only understand hearing the sound, not appreciating its depth,
The music comes and goes freely like a gale in the wind.
Withered mulberries and ancient cypresses whistle in the cold,
Nine young phoenixes chirp and twitter in confusion.
Dragon roars and tiger howls burst forth all at once,
All of nature's sounds and a hundred springs merge into the voice of autumn.
Suddenly it shifts into the悲壮 Yuyang Can,
Yellow clouds hang desolate, the bright sun turns dim.
The tone changes, and one seems to hear the lightness of 'Willow Spring',
The blooming flowers of Shanglin Garden shine fresh before the eyes.
On New Year's Eve, bright candles are lit in the high hall,
A cup of fine wine, a strain of song.

background: 《听安万善吹觱篥歌》为唐代李颀所作。唐代是中国诗歌的黄金时代，初唐四杰承先启后，盛唐李杜高岑王孟群星璀璨，中唐元白韩孟柳刘各擅胜场，晚唐小李杜温李余韵悠长，古近体各体皆备。作者李颀在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Bamboo cut from the southern mountains is fashioned into the bili pipe,
This instrument originally came from the kingdom of Kucha.
After spreading to Han lands, its melodies grew even more wondrous,
A barbarian from Liangzhou plays it for me.
Neighbors who hear it mostly heave sighs,
Travelers far from home all shed homesick tears.
Worldly people only understand hearing the sound, not appreciating its depth,
The music comes and goes freely like a gale in the wind.
Withered mulberries and ancient cypresses whistle in the cold,
Nine young phoenixes chirp and twitter in confusion.
Dragon roars and tiger howls burst forth all at once,
All of nature's sounds and a hundred springs merge into the voice of autumn.
Suddenly it shifts into the悲壮 Yuyang Can,
Yellow clouds hang desolate, the bright sun turns dim.
The tone changes, and one seems to hear the lightness of 'Willow Spring',
The blooming flowers of Shanglin Garden shine fresh before the eyes.
On New Year's Eve, bright candles are lit in the high hall,
A cup of fine wine, a strain of song.

这种乐器本来出自龟兹国。

凉州的胡人为我吹奏它。
邻近的人听了大多叹息，
远游的客人思乡，都流下泪来。
世人只懂得听声音，不懂得欣赏其中深意，
乐声像狂风中自由自在地往来。
枯桑老柏在寒风中飕飗作响，
九只小凤凰杂乱地啾啾鸣叫。
龙吟虎啸般的声音一时迸发，
万籁齐鸣，百泉飞溅，汇成秋声。

黄云萧条，白日也变得昏暗。

上林苑的繁花照得人眼目清新。
除夕之夜，高堂上点着明亮的蜡烛，
饮一杯美酒，听一曲歌声。

title: 听董大弹胡笳声兼寄语弄房给事
author: 李颀
note: 【听董大弹胡笳声兼寄语弄房给事】唐代李颀所作的诗。
tr: 蔡女昔造胡笳聲，一彈一十有八拍。胡人落淚沾邊草，漢使斷腸對歸客。古戍蒼蒼烽火寒，大荒沈沈飛雪白。先拂商弦後角羽，四郊秋葉驚摵摵。董夫子，通神明，深山竊聽來妖精。言遲更速皆應手，將往復旋如有情。空山百鳥散還合，萬里浮雲陰且晴。嘶酸雛鴈失羣夜，斷絕胡兒戀母聲。川爲淨其波，鳥亦罷其鳴。烏孫部落家鄉遠，邏娑沙塵哀怨生。幽音變調忽飄灑，長風吹林雨墮瓦。迸泉颯颯飛木末，野鹿呦呦走堂下。長安城連東掖垣，鳳凰池對青瑣門。高才脫略名與利，日夕望君抱琴至。
appr: 《听董大弹胡笳声兼寄语弄房给事》是唐代李颀所作的诗名篇。全诗共27句，章法舒展，语言自然，情真意切。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为唐代诗歌的经典篇章，《听董大弹胡笳声兼寄语弄房给事》历代传诵不衰，是李颀诗歌风格的集中体现。

en_body: Of old, Lady Cai composed the Barbarian Reed Pipe melody,
One playing contains eighteen stanzas.
Barbarians who heard it shed tears that dampened the frontier grass,
Han envoys, facing the homeward traveler, were heartbroken.
Ancient watchtowers stand gray, beacon fires grown cold,
The great wilderness lies deep, white snow flying.
First brushing the Shang string, then Jue and Yu,
Autumn leaves in the four suburbs startle and rustle down.
Master Dong,
Your art communicates with the spirits,
Even demons and spirits in deep mountains steal in to listen.
Slow notes and fast notes all respond to your hand,
Pausing, returning, turning, as if full of deep feeling.
In empty mountains, a hundred birds scatter, then gather again,
Ten thousand li of clouds turn from overcast to clear.
A lost young goose cries hoarsely in the night,
The barbarian child's cry for its mother dies away.
Rivers still their waves for it,
Birds cease their singing.
The Wusun princess's tribe was far from home,
From the sands of Lhasa, sorrow and complaint arose.
The dark, suppressed tone suddenly turns free and flowing,
Like long winds through forests, rain falling on tiles.
Gushing springs whistle as they fly to treetops,
Wild deer call 'yo-yo' as they run below the hall.
Chang'an city adjoins the eastern palace walls,
Phoenix Pool faces the Blue Lattice Gate.
Lord Fang, your talent rises above fame and gain,
Day and night we long for you to come, lute in hand.

baihua_lines: 从前蔡文姬创作了胡笳曲，
一弹就是十八个段落。
胡人听了落泪，沾湿边地的草，
汉使面对归乡的她，悲伤断肠。
古老的戍楼苍苍，烽火冰冷，
大荒沉沉，白雪纷飞。
先拂过商弦，再弹角弦羽弦，
四郊秋叶被惊得簌簌落下。
董夫子啊，
您的琴艺通于神明，
连深山里的妖精鬼怪都偷偷来听。
慢声快声都得心应手，
将往复旋，仿佛饱含感情。
空山中百鸟散去又聚拢，
万里浮云阴了又晴。
失群的幼雁在夜里嘶酸地哀鸣，
胡儿恋母的哭声断绝。
江河为它净静了波涛，
鸟儿也停止了鸣叫。
乌孙公主的部落家乡遥远，
逻娑的沙尘哀怨相生。
幽咽的音调忽然变得飘洒，
长风吹林，雨点落在瓦上。
迸溅的泉水飒飒飞向树梢，
野鹿呦呦鸣叫着从堂下跑过。
长安城连接着东边的宫墙，
凤凰池正对着青琐门。
房给事您才学高，超脱名利，
日夜盼望您抱琴前来。

en_body: The host has wine for our revelry tonight,
And bids the guest, master of the Guangling San, play upon the lute.
Moonlight shines on the city walls, crows half flying, half perched,
Frost chills the ten thousand trees, autumn wind piercing through garments.
Bronze burners and bright candles add their glow,
First playing 'The Clear Water', then 'Lament of the Chu Consort'.
At the first note all things fall still,
The whole assembly sits silent, the stars growing few.
Commissioned to Qinghuai, a thousand li from home,
I dare say my retreat to clouded mountains begins tonight.

title: 送陈章甫
author: 李颀

en_body: In April the south wind blows, the barley turning golden,
Date blossoms have not yet fallen, paulownia shade already grown long.
You bid green mountains farewell at dawn, yet see them again at dusk,
Your horse neighs as you depart, longing for your old home.
Lord Chen, how open and upright is your conduct in the world,
With curling whiskers, tiger brows, and a broad, high forehead.
Within your breast you store ten thousand scrolls of learning,
Refusing to bow your head and be forgotten among the weeds.
At the east gate you bought wine to drink with us,
Holding all the world's concerns light as wild goose feathers.
Drunk you lie asleep, unaware that daylight has faded,
Sometimes gazing up at a lone cloud drifting high.
The great river's waves darken the sky to the horizon,
Boats are moored at the ford, unable to cross.
You, traveler from Zheng, have not yet reached your home,
And I, wayfarer from Luoyang, sigh in vain.
I hear you have many old acquaintances in your homeland,
Dismissed from office yesterday — how fare you today?

卷曲的胡须，虎一样的浓眉，额头宽阔。

en_body: At dawn I hear the traveler sing a song of parting,
Last night the first light frost fell as you crossed the Yellow River.
The cries of wild geese are unbearable to hear in sorrow,
All the more so when clouded mountains are seen as a stranger on the road.
The color of trees around the frontier pass hastens the cold's approach,
The sound of washing mallets by the imperial gardens grows loud toward evening.
Do not see Chang'an merely as a place for pleasure,
Letting the years slip idly by in vain.

Do not see Chang'an merely as a place for pleasure,
Letting the years slip idly by in vain.
baihua_lines: 清晨听到游子高唱离别之歌，
昨夜初下微霜，你刚刚渡过黄河。
愁绪中不忍心听鸿雁哀鸣，
更何况是在客途中走过云绕的山路。
关城旁的树色催着寒意逼近，
御苑里的捣衣声到晚来格外密集。
不要只看见长安是行乐的地方，
白白让岁月轻易蹉跎过去。
baihua: 朝闻游子唱离歌，昨夜微霜初渡河。鸿鴈不堪愁里听，云山况是客中过。关城树色催寒近，御苑砧声向晚多。莫见长安行乐处，空令岁月易蹉跎。
en_lines: At dawn I hear the traveler sing a song of parting,
Last night the first light frost fell as you crossed the Yellow River.
The cries of wild geese are unbearable to hear in sorrow,
All the more so when clouded mountains are seen as a stranger on the road.
The color of trees around the frontier pass hastens the cold's approach,
The sound of washing mallets by the imperial gardens grows loud toward evening.
Do not see Chang'an merely as a place for pleasure,
Letting the years slip idly by in vain.

author: 李频

title: 和晋陵陆丞早春游望
author: 杜审言
note: 【和晋陵陆丞早春游望】唐代杜审言所作的诗。

The gentle spring air urges the orioles to sing,
In clear sunlight, the duckweed on the water turns green.

My homesickness makes tears nearly wet my kerchief.

I sink into quiet thought, my heart growing heavy.
A lone lamp on a cold night lights my memories of old times,
The cry of a lost wild goose startles me from my sorrowful sleep.
My distant dream of returning home lasted until dawn,
Letters from home take a year to reach me here.
The misty moon over the Xiang River is so fair,
But the fishing boats moored by the door belong to others.

author: 杜牧

en_body: The autumn glow of silver candles shines coldly on the painted screen,
She holds a light silk fan to chase the flitting fireflies.
The palace steps are as cool as water in the night,
Lying down she watches the Herdboy and Weaver Girl stars across the Silver River.
Mid-Autumn Moon
Du Mu
Evening clouds have cleared away, cold radiance fills the sky,
The Silver River turns silently, the full moon like a jade disk.
In this life such moonlit nights will not come often,
Next year, where will I be to watch the bright moon?

Waves stir on the Five Lakes, autumn rising.
Do not let the sorrow of parting startle the birds,
We have already become two gulls, forgetting the world.

en_body: At the parting feast, I brush away pearllike tears,

The flowing water follows the traveler of its own accord, receding far away,
The green willows still grow along the banks of the Qu River.

Indulging in the slender Chu beauties who danced light in the palm, lost in tender feeling.
After ten years, Yangzhou seems but a dream,
Having earned nothing but a name for faithlessness among the blue mansions.
